risks: Supplier Rs 180 price is a snippet with no MOQ; confirm size, brass jali and finish
Weight with packing may exceed 1 kg; le_2kg slab assumed
Some marketplace 'sheesham' listings are mango/engineered wood; demand supplier written confirmation before claiming sheesham
Do not claim 'food safe' finish without evidence; describe as serving/decor tray
Wood cracking/warping and corner dents in transit; needs corner protection
UP supplier: website only via bill-to-ship-to unless an Odisha supplier is found
GST: HSN 4419 wooden tableware assumed 12% (may be 5% after 22-09-2025 rate change); CA to confirm

review.notes: Rs 799 is competitive (15x10 in brass-inlay wood tray Rs 899 on Vibecity, sheesham 14x10/14x9 Rs 899-1,175 on Amazon.in), but the Rs 180 cost for a 15x10 sheesham tray with brass jali is an unopened TradeIndia snippet and looks too low next to Ace Wood's Rs 249 for a plain 10x10 tray; because the UP supplier makes it website-only (Shopify), 30% holds only up to ~Rs 230 cost (Rs 250 -> 27.6%). Need a written quote for the exact 15x10 in tray stating genuine sheesham (not mango/acacia), solid brass jali vs brass-coloured sheet, finish, packed weight/dimensions and MOQ, plus photos with permission.
